description: Renames a Riddle with the specified UUID. Returns only the confirmation of the change (uuid, title, modified state), not the entire Riddle. Only if the Riddle's origin.writableByThisKey is true (riddle_get, riddle_list): riddle://reference/concepts/access.

UUID.description: The UUID of the Riddle you want to rename

title.description: The new title for the Riddle

name: riddle_rename
